_doc: THE ENGINE THIS CONTRACT MODULE'S CLIENT BINDS (#871, engine-apk-split move 12). Same shape as libs:git-sync's declaration: Cloud Drive compiles libs:mounts (the screen, the models, the mount list, the credential store and this client) and does not compile the mounts engine that runs the ftp / sftp / ssh / webdav clients. `fleet` is the Store row in aa_cloud-superapp/data/constellation-fleet.json from which build.gradle resolves the package (an unknown id fails the build) into BuildConfig and the merged <queries>; `action` finds the service ({package} substituted at build time, matching the engine manifest's ${applicationId}.ENGINE); `min_contract` is the lowest engine CONTRACT that answers every method EngineFs calls, read through PackageManager BEFORE binding. With the engine absent the screen shows the sentence that says what to install, never a crash.
